tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: pure white in light themes, near-black in dark. Sections sit directly on it; never box a whole section. Also the fill of inputs on a `surface` panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that hold one object: the tool form, a tool card, the sample report. Neutral gray, set apart from `bg` by tone, not by a border.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet bands (daily strip, pricing line), hover fill, chips and chart cells on `surface`. One step deeper than `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting paragraphs and descriptions on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, disclaimers, meta lines on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` (≥4.6:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between list rows and the footer top. Decorative only; never the only cue that separates two objects.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Input and select outlines (≥3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2` in every theme).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one small spot of colour. East: pine, for the seal, the active nav mark, the tool-card glyph and the chart highlight. West: brass, for digits and the star. Marks and large glyphs only (≥3:1); never body text, never a button fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and inline emphasis: the same value as `ink`, always underlined so links do not rely on colour.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Muted brick, for error states and destructive (delete) actions only: field error outline, error icon and message, the fill of a delete button. Text ≥4.5:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2`. Never decoration, never a brand colour.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `danger` button.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button: ink black in light themes, near-white in dark.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`, and the seal characters on `accent`.

tokens.name: illus
tokens.usage: Line-art strokes and the glyphs inside the motif. Decoration only, never text that must be read.

tokens.name: wx-wood
tokens.usage: Five-element wood, with its label. Chart dots and bars only.

tokens.name: wx-fire
tokens.usage: Five-element fire, with its label. Chart dots and bars only; never a brand or UI colour.

tokens.name: wx-earth
tokens.usage: Five-element earth, with its label. Chart dots and bars only.

tokens.name: wx-metal
tokens.usage: Five-element metal, with its label. Chart dots and bars only.

tokens.name: wx-water
tokens.usage: Five-element water, with its label. Chart dots and bars only.
